brief.headline: Push for a 76% price cut to ₹250/KG — market asks for pharma laminate sit at ₹205–305/kg, yet we pay ₹1067.36/KG

priceAsk.summary: Ask Huhtamaki to match the market-fair price of ₹250/KG for laminate
priceAsk.basis: Market asks for pharma/ORS sachet laminate run ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), and Silk Polypack already gives us ₹250.00/KG — yet Huhtamaki charges ₹1067.36/KG, a 326.9% gap. Import prices for BOPET film substrate are ₹171.60/kg, so our price carries huge embedded cost or margin that the market does not support.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to payment on delivery (net-zero terms)
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹6316 in cash for us

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki publishes no financials, so we cannot see how healthy or cash-tight they are. Our ₹76850 annual spend is tiny for a listed packaging company, meaning we have almost no revenue leverage. Because we lack financial visibility and bargaining power, the strategy must rest on the huge price gap to market and on building a credible second source. Push hard on price — the gap is enormous and well-documented — but be ready to walk if they won't move, because we are not a material customer to them.

evidence.point: We pay Huhtamaki more than four times the market price for laminate
Another supplier already gives us the market-fair price
Market asks for pharma/ORS sachet laminate sit in a narrow, fair band well below our price
The raw film substrate itself trades far below what we pay for finished laminate
Closing the price gap saves us meaningful money on this small spend
Our total spend with Huhtamaki is very small

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant that makes both the film substrate and does conversion; can second-source laminate at scale

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter for pharma blister and sachet laminates; revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health score D (31/100) — a strong second-source for laminate

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Global Amcor's India arm specializing in high-end pharma laminates; premium but very reliable

risks: Huhtamaki is a listed packaging major and our spend is tiny (₹76850), so they may simply refuse to engage or walk away
We have no visibility into their finances, so we cannot gauge how desperate or stable they are — the ask must stand purely on the market evidence
If they justify the premium with a unique spec or service (e.g., cleanroom conversion, regulatory support), we need to verify whether that is worth the 326.9% gap or if alternates offer the same
Alternate suppliers listed are leads from public research — none are qualified, audited or priced yet, so line up RFQs in parallel to this negotiation
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to work with you long-term, but right now we're paying ₹1067.36/KG when the market for pharma laminate runs ₹205–305 and another vendor gives us ₹250 — can you help us understand that gap and get to a fair price?
